title: Sources: Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang; Haas worked at Nvidia more than a decade ago (Michael Acton/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Acton / Financial Times: Sources: Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang; Haas worked at Nvidia more than a decade ago — Head of SoftBank-owned UK semiconductor group sounded out after Jensen Huang resigned over affairs
